title.narrative: Climate-Resilient Energy and Water Sector Project

description.narrative: The project will finance investment in renewable energy generation and related facilities in the smaller islands of the FSMhelping improve access to electricity and drinking water, enhancing climate resilience of livelihoods through bolstering energy security, reducing reliance on fossil fuels for power generation improving the utilization of renewable energy and rehabilitating dilapidated renewable energy infrastructure.
